title: kith-chat: ChatSetHandler group chat support (kind=group, N participants)
description:
What: Extend ChatSetHandler to support creating group chats with N participants.

Algorithm:
1. In process_chat_create (kith-chat/chat.rs), extract optional kind field (default: "direct").
2. If kind == "group":
   a. Extract participantIds: Vec<String> from args (required field).
   b. Validate: at least 2 participants, max 50, all non-empty strings.
   c. Ensure owner_id is included in participantIds (add if missing).
   d. Sort participantIds lexicographically.
   e. Compute chat_id = compute_chat_id(&sorted_ids).
   f. For each participant other than owner, verify a contact row exists in contacts table.
   g. Call store.chats().get_or_create(&chat_id, "group", &sorted_ids, now_unix).
3. If kind == "direct" (existing behavior):
   a. Extract single contactId from args.
   b. Existing flow unchanged.
4. On success, return chat object with participants populated.

Defensive rules: participantIds are opaque strings, never parsed as email; owner always included; deduplicate participants before sorting; reject if any participant has no contact row (prevents group with unknown peers).

Agent team: R reads existing ChatSetHandler and compute_chat_id; I implements; T writes tests: create direct chat (regression), create 3-person group chat, compute expected chatId with Python sha256 oracle, verify stored participants; V runs cargo test -p kith-chat + clippy.
